_meta.purpose: Battery (BESS) efficiency, SOC limits, dispatch thresholds and sizing-sweep settings.

charge_window_start.assumption: Illustrative overnight recharge window; replace with operating policy. Recharge also respects the peak-shaving demand target.

charge_window_end.assumption: Illustrative overnight recharge window; replace with operating policy. Recharge also respects the peak-shaving demand target.

initial_soc_pct.assumption: Illustrative initial stored energy of half capacity; user configurable, not a periodic terminal-SOC guarantee.

telemetry_max_age_seconds.assumption: Illustrative replay freshness window equal to one 15-minute simulation step; not a real hardware sampling guarantee.
